title: Annotatio IV §.XX open: Danhauer and Strauch try to claim Waldenses as Lutheran Supper allies
pass_a_gloss: §. XX. And this is the cause why a Pair of most Famous Lutheran Theologians — JOHANNES CONRADUS DANHAUER of Strasbourg and ÆGIDIUS STRAUCH of Wittenberg — in their Dissertations on the Waldensian Church, about to reconcile these with their own faith concerning the Sacred Supper and to show the Waldenses as witnesses and allies of the Lutheran faith,
pass_b_english: §.XX: this is why two famous Lutheran theologians — DANHAUER of Strasbourg and STRAUCH of Wittenberg — write dissertations on the Waldensian Church.
They mean to reconcile the Waldenses with their own Supper faith and show them as witnesses and allies of the Lutheran faith.
source_text: §. XX. Et hæc est causa quare Biga Clarissimorum Theologorum Lutheranorum, JOHANNES CONRADUS DANHAUERUS Argentoratensis, & ÆGIDIUS STRAUCHIUS Wittebergensis, in suis, de Waldensium Ecclesia, Dissertationibus, horum, cum sua, de S. Cœna, fide, conciliatura & Waldenses Lutheranæ fidei testes & socios ostensura,

lemmas.gloss: witnesses and allies of the Lutheran faith
